_comment: Plugins pinned by exact version for the CI corpus check.
The full corpus is fifty plugins at latest-stable, which is right for triage
and wrong for a tracked number: it moves whenever upstream releases, and a
baseline that drifts on its own teaches people to ignore it.
These eight are pinned, and chosen to exercise different machinery rather
than to be the most popular:
akismet               the stays-clean canary; tuned to zero and expected to hold
cookie-law-info       admin views reached through includes
wp-super-cache        allowlist regexes, and filters that feed a filename
wpforms-lite          keyed arrays crossing a call boundary, and numeric keys
duplicate-post        small and quiet; catches a change that taints everything
Bump a version deliberately, and treat the baseline diff as the review.
